metadata.description: Name of the Log Analytics workspace hosting Microsoft Sentinel.

properties.description: Approved Azure OpenAI / Microsoft Foundry content filter policy configurations. Used by analytic rules to detect removal or weakening of content filter policies on deployed models. Each row defines an approved policy name and its minimum required configuration thresholds. Populate ItemKey with a unique policy identifier per row. Rows with Status=Template are shipped as schema examples and should be replaced with real policy data before relying on watchlist-based detections.
